params.name: Boost textures too
params.tooltip:
DEV. On: the boost also sets texture quality to Very High
(may reload textures, slow).

params.name: Restore at pause menu
params.tooltip:
DEV. Yes: restore the player's settings when the pause menu opens.
No: leave the boost on; only the next game load restores it.

params.name: Camera tool LOD scaling
params.tooltip:
DEV. Camera tool geometry tier lodDistanceScaling at load
(base 5.0).

params.name: Camera tool draw distance
params.tooltip:
DEV. Camera tool geometry tier far plane at load
(base 22.5 km).

params.name: High tier
params.tooltip:
DEV. Camera tool: the High geometry tier gets the base camera
tool's draw distance and LOD scaling (22.5 km, 5.0) at load.

params.name: Camera tool preview LOD
params.tooltip:
DEV. Camera tool preview geometry tier lodDistanceScaling
at load (base 1.0).
